section_summary.extract_value: This preliminary analyses section reports Table 1 comparing Zimbabwean women in Britain (migrants) with counterparts in Zimbabwe (non-migrants). It states there were no significant between-group differences in participant age, self-reported BMI, or ethnic distribution, but migrants reported greater lifetime exposure to Western media and lower exposure to Zimbabwean media. The section does not label any study as 'Study 1' or indicate multiple distinct studies.
section_summary.evidence_source: Table 1 presents descriptive statistics and the results of independent samples t-tests between Zimbabwean women in Britain and their counterparts in Zimbabwe for all variables included in this study. As can be seen, preliminary analyses showed that there were no significant between-group differences in participant age and self-reported BMI. There was also no significant between-group difference in the distribution of ethnic groups, -2(6) = 5.04, p = .539, ϕ = .13. Table 1 also shows that the migrant group reported significantly greater lifetime exposure to Western media and significantly lower lifetime exposure to Zimbabwean media.
